passages.text: In the eighth month of the second year of Darius, the word of the LORD came to the prophet Zechariah son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo, saying: “The LORD was very angry with your fathers.
passages.sermon:
Zechariah was a prophet.
Zechariah was the son of Berechiah.
Berechiah was the son of Iddo.
Darius was king.
This happened in the second year of Darius.
This happened in the eighth month.
The word of the LORD came to Zechariah.
The LORD spoke to Zechariah.
The LORD said, “I was very angry with your fathers.”
passages.original: בַּחֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ הַשְּׁמִינִ֔י בִּשְׁנַ֥ת שְׁתַּ֖יִם לְדָרְיָ֑וֶשׁ הָיָ֣ה דְבַר־ יְהוָ֗ה אֶל־ זְכַרְיָה֙ בֶּן־ בֶּ֣רֶכְיָ֔ה בֶּן־ עִדּ֥וֹ הַנָּבִ֖יא לֵאמֹֽר׃ קָצַ֧ף יְהוָ֛ה עַל־ אֲבֽוֹתֵיכֶ֖ם קָֽצֶף׃

passages.text: So tell the people that this is what the LORD of Hosts says: ‘Return to Me, declares the LORD of Hosts, and I will return to you, says the LORD of Hosts.’
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts spoke to Zechariah the prophet.
The LORD of Hosts is the God who commands all the armies of heaven.
The LORD of Hosts said, "Return to Me."
The LORD of Hosts promised, "I will return to you."
The LORD of Hosts gave this message to the people.
passages.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵהֶ֗ם כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת שׁ֣וּבוּ אֵלַ֔י נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת וְאָשׁ֣וּב אֲלֵיכֶ֔ם אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃

passages.text: Do not be like your fathers, to whom the former prophets proclaimed that this is what the LORD of Hosts says: ‘Turn now from your evil ways and deeds.’ But they did not listen or pay attention to Me, declares the LORD.
passages.sermon:
Zechariah was a prophet.
God spoke to Zechariah.
God told Zechariah to speak to the people.
God said, "Do not be like your fathers."
The former prophets spoke to your fathers.
The prophets said, "This is what the LORD of Hosts says."
The LORD of Hosts said, "Turn now from your evil ways."
The LORD of Hosts said, "Turn from your evil deeds."
Your fathers did not listen to Me.
Your fathers did not pay attention to Me.
The LORD declares this.
passages.original: אַל־ תִּהְי֣וּ כַאֲבֹֽתֵיכֶ֡ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר קָרְאֽוּ־ אֲלֵיהֶם֩ הַנְּבִיאִ֨ים הָרִֽאשֹׁנִ֜ים לֵאמֹ֗ר כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת שׁ֤וּבוּ נָא֙ מִדַּרְכֵיכֶ֣ם הָרָעִ֔ים וּמַעֲלִילֵיכֶם הָֽרָעִ֑ים וְלֹ֥א שָׁמְע֛וּ וְלֹֽא־ הִקְשִׁ֥יבוּ אֵלַ֖י נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Where are your fathers now? And the prophets, do they live forever?
passages.sermon:
Your fathers lived long ago.
Now your fathers are gone.
The prophets spoke to your fathers.
The prophets do not live forever.
passages.original: אֲבֽוֹתֵיכֶ֖ם אַיֵּה־ הֵ֑ם וְהַ֨נְּבִאִ֔ים הַלְעוֹלָ֖ם יִֽחְיֽוּ׃

passages.text: But did not My words and My statutes, which I commanded My servants the prophets, overtake your fathers? They repented and said, ‘Just as the LORD of Hosts purposed to do to us according to our ways and deeds, so He has done to us.’ ”
passages.sermon:
God gave commands and laws to His prophets.
God told the prophets to speak to the people.
God’s words and laws reached your fathers.
God’s words overtook your fathers.
Your fathers turned back to God.
Your fathers said, “The LORD of Hosts planned to act against us because of our ways and deeds.
He has done to us as He planned.”
passages.original: אַ֣ךְ׀ דְּבָרַ֣י וְחֻקַּ֗י אֲשֶׁ֤ר צִוִּ֙יתִי֙ אֶת־ עֲבָדַ֣י הַנְּבִיאִ֔ים הֲל֥וֹא הִשִּׂ֖יגוּ אֲבֹתֵיכֶ֑ם וַיָּשׁ֣וּבוּ וַיֹּאמְר֗וּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר זָמַ֜ם יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת לָ֔נוּ כִּדְרָכֵ֙ינוּ֙ וּכְמַ֣עֲלָלֵ֔ינוּ כֵּ֖ן עָשָׂ֥ה אִתָּֽנוּ׃ס

passages.text: On the twenty-fourth day of the eleventh month, the month of Shebat, in the second year of Darius, the word of the LORD came to the prophet Zechariah son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo.
passages.sermon:
Zechariah was a prophet.
Zechariah was the son of Berechiah.
Berechiah was the son of Iddo.
Darius was king.
This happened in the second year of Darius’s reign.
The month was Shebat.
Shebat is the eleventh month.
The day was the twenty-fourth day of the month.
On that day, the word of the LORD came to Zechariah.
passages.original: בְּיוֹם֩ עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֜ה לְעַשְׁתֵּֽי־ עָשָׂ֥ר חֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ הוּא־ חֹ֣דֶשׁ שְׁבָ֔ט בִּשְׁנַ֥ת שְׁתַּ֖יִם לְדָרְיָ֑וֶשׁ הָיָ֣ה דְבַר־ יְהוָ֗ה אֶל־ זְכַרְיָה֙ בֶּן־ בֶּ֣רֶכְיָ֔הוּ בֶּן־ עִדּ֥וֹא הַנָּבִ֖יא לֵאמֹֽר׃

passages.text: I looked out into the night and saw a man riding on a red horse. He was standing among the myrtle trees in the hollow, and behind him were red, sorrel, and white horses.
passages.sermon:
The prophet Zechariah saw a vision at night.
Zechariah saw a man riding a red horse.
The man stood among myrtle trees.
The myrtle trees were in a low place, a hollow.
Behind the man were other horses.
The horses behind him were red, sorrel, and white.
passages.original: רָאִ֣יתִי׀ הַלַּ֗יְלָה וְהִנֵּה־ אִישׁ֙ רֹכֵב֙ עַל־ ס֣וּס אָדֹ֔ם וְה֣וּא עֹמֵ֔ד בֵּ֥ין הַהֲדַסִּ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּמְּצֻלָ֑ה וְאַחֲרָיו֙ סוּסִ֣ים אֲדֻמִּ֔ים שְׂרֻקִּ֖ים וּלְבָנִֽים׃

passages.text: “What are these, my lord?” I asked. And the angel who was speaking with me replied, “I will show you what they are.”
passages.sermon:
Zechariah was a prophet.
God spoke to Zechariah in a vision at night.
Zechariah saw horses and riders.
Zechariah did not know what they were.
Zechariah asked, “What are these, my lord?”
An angel was speaking with Zechariah.
The angel answered Zechariah.
The angel said, “I will show you what they are.”
passages.original: וָאֹמַ֖ר מָה־ אֵ֣לֶּה אֲדֹנִ֑י וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֗י הַמַּלְאָךְ֙ הַדֹּבֵ֣ר בִּ֔י אֲנִ֥י אַרְאֶ֖ךָּ מָה־ הֵ֥מָּה אֵֽלֶּה׃

passages.text: Then the man standing among the myrtle trees explained, “They are the ones the LORD has sent to patrol the earth.”
passages.sermon:
A man stood among the myrtle trees.
This man spoke.
He explained about the horses and riders.
He said, “The LORD sent these ones.”
The LORD sent them to patrol the earth.
passages.original: וַיַּ֗עַן הָאִ֛ישׁ הָעֹמֵ֥ד בֵּין־ הַהַדַסִּ֖ים וַיֹּאמַ֑ר אֵ֚לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁלַ֣ח יְהוָ֔ה לְהִתְהַלֵּ֖ךְ בָּאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: And the riders answered the angel of the LORD who was standing among the myrtle trees, “We have patrolled the earth, and behold, all the earth is at rest and tranquil.”
passages.sermon:
The riders spoke to the angel of the LORD.
The angel of the LORD was standing among the myrtle trees.
The riders said, “We have patrolled the earth.”
They said, “All the earth is at rest.”
They said, “All the earth is tranquil.”
passages.original: וַֽיַּעֲנ֞וּ אֶת־ מַלְאַ֣ךְ יְהוָ֗ה הָֽעֹמֵד֙ בֵּ֣ין הַהֲדַסִּ֔ים וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ הִתְהַלַּ֣כְנוּ בָאָ֑רֶץ וְהִנֵּ֥ה כָל־ הָאָ֖רֶץ יֹשֶׁ֥בֶת וְשֹׁקָֽטֶת׃

passages.text: Then the angel of the LORD said, “How long, O LORD of Hosts, will You withhold mercy from Jerusalem and the cities of Judah, with which You have been angry these seventy years?”
passages.sermon:
The angel of the LORD spoke.
The angel asked the LORD of Hosts a question.
The angel said, “LORD of Hosts, how long will You withhold mercy?”
The angel spoke about Jerusalem and the cities of Judah.
The angel said the LORD had been angry with them.
The angel said this anger had lasted seventy years.
passages.original: וַיַּ֣עַן מַלְאַךְ־ יְהוָה֮ וַיֹּאמַר֒ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת עַד־ מָתַ֗י אַתָּה֙ לֹֽא־ תְרַחֵ֣ם אֶת־ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם וְאֵ֖ת עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר זָעַ֔מְתָּה זֶ֖ה שִׁבְעִ֥ים שָׁנָֽה׃

passages.text: So the LORD spoke kind and comforting words to the angel who was speaking with me.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to the angel.
The angel was speaking with me.
The LORD spoke kind words.
The LORD spoke words that comforted.
passages.original: וַיַּ֣עַן יְהוָ֗ה אֶת־ הַמַּלְאָ֛ךְ הַדֹּבֵ֥ר בִּ֖י דְּבָרִ֣ים טוֹבִ֑ים דְּבָרִ֖ים נִחֻמִֽים׃

passages.text: Then the angel who was speaking with me said, “Proclaim this word: This is what the LORD of Hosts says: ‘I am very jealous for Jerusalem and Zion, but I am fiercely angry with the nations that are at ease. For I was a little angry, but they have added to the calamity.’
passages.sermon:
The angel was speaking with me.
The angel said to me, "Proclaim this message."
The LORD of Hosts says this.
The LORD is very jealous for Jerusalem.
The LORD is very jealous for Zion.
The LORD is fiercely angry with the nations that are at ease.
The LORD was a little angry before.
The nations made the trouble worse.
The nations added to the calamity.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֗י הַמַּלְאָךְ֙ הַדֹּבֵ֣ר בִּ֔י קְרָ֣א לֵאמֹ֔ר כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת קִנֵּ֧אתִי לִירוּשָׁלִַ֛ם וּלְצִיּ֖וֹן קִנְאָ֥ה גְדוֹלָֽה׃ וְקֶ֤צֶף גָּדוֹל֙ אֲנִ֣י קֹצֵ֔ף עַל־ הַגּוֹיִ֖ם הַשַּֽׁאֲנַנִּ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֲנִי֙ קָצַ֣פְתִּי מְּעָ֔ט וְהֵ֖מָּה עָזְר֥וּ לְרָעָֽה׃

passages.text: Therefore this is what the LORD says: ‘I will return to Jerusalem with mercy, and there My house will be rebuilt, declares the LORD of Hosts, and a measuring line will be stretched out over Jerusalem.’
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts is speaking.
The LORD says, “I will return to Jerusalem.
I will show mercy to Jerusalem.
My house will be rebuilt in Jerusalem.
I, the LORD of Hosts, declare this.
A measuring line will be stretched out over Jerusalem.”
passages.original: לָכֵ֞ן כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה שַׁ֤בְתִּי לִירוּשָׁלִַ֙ם֙ בְּֽרַחֲמִ֔ים בֵּיתִי֙ יִבָּ֣נֶה בָּ֔הּ נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת וְקָוָה יִנָּטֶ֖ה עַל־ יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

passages.text: Proclaim further that this is what the LORD of Hosts says: ‘My cities will again overflow with prosperity; the LORD will again comfort Zion and choose Jerusalem.’ ”
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts is God.
God speaks with great authority.
God says, "My cities will overflow with prosperity again."
God will bless His cities with abundance.
God will comfort Zion again.
God will choose Jerusalem again.
passages.original: ע֣וֹד׀ קְרָ֣א לֵאמֹ֗ר כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת ע֛וֹד תְּפוּצֶ֥ינָה עָרַ֖י מִטּ֑וֹב וְנִחַ֨ם יְהוָ֥ה עוֹד֙ אֶת־ צִיּ֔וֹן וּבָחַ֥ר ע֖וֹד בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃ס

passages.text: Then I looked up and saw four horns.
passages.sermon: The prophet Zechariah looked up.\r\nHe saw something.\r\nHe saw four horns.
passages.original: וָאֶשָּׂ֥א אֶת־ עֵינַ֖י וָאֵ֑רֶא וְהִנֵּ֖ה אַרְבַּ֥ע קְרָנֽוֹת׃

passages.text: So I asked the angel who was speaking with me, “What are these?” And he told me, “These are the horns that have scattered Judah, Israel, and Jerusalem.”
passages.sermon:
The prophet Zechariah saw a vision.
An angel spoke with Zechariah.
Zechariah asked the angel a question.
He said, “What are these?”
The angel answered Zechariah.
The angel said, “These are the horns.”
The horns scattered Judah.
The horns scattered Israel.
The horns scattered Jerusalem.
passages.original: וָאֹמַ֗ר אֶל־ הַמַּלְאָ֛ךְ הַדֹּבֵ֥ר בִּ֖י מָה־ אֵ֑לֶּה וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔י אֵ֤לֶּה הַקְּרָנוֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר זֵר֣וּ אֶת־ יְהוּדָ֔ה אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וִירוּשָׁלָֽם׃ס

passages.text: Then the LORD showed me four craftsmen.
passages.sermon:
The LORD appeared to me.
The LORD showed me something.
I saw four craftsmen.
The craftsmen stood before me.
The LORD revealed these four craftsmen to me.

passages.text: “What are these coming to do?” I asked. And He replied, “These are the horns that scattered Judah so that no one could raise his head; but the craftsmen have come to terrify them and throw down these horns of the nations that have lifted up their horns against the land of Judah to scatter it.”
passages.sermon:
The prophet Zechariah saw a vision from God.
Zechariah spoke to the angel who talked with him.
Zechariah asked, "What are these coming to do?"
The angel answered Zechariah.
The angel said, "These are the horns."
The horns scattered Judah.
The horns scattered Judah so badly that no one could lift his head.
The craftsmen have come.
The craftsmen have come to terrify the horns.
The craftsmen have come to throw down the horns of the nations.
These nations lifted up their horns against the land of Judah.
These nations scattered the land of Judah.
passages.original: וָאֹמַ֕ר מָ֛ה אֵ֥לֶּה בָאִ֖ים לַֽעֲשׂ֑וֹת וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לֵאמֹ֗ר אֵ֣לֶּה הַקְּרָנ֞וֹת אֲשֶׁר־ זֵ֣רוּ אֶת־ יְהוּדָ֗ה כְּפִי־ אִישׁ֙ לֹא־ נָשָׂ֣א רֹאשׁ֔וֹ וַיָּבֹ֤אוּ אֵ֙לֶּה֙ לְהַחֲרִ֣יד אֹתָ֔ם לְיַדּ֞וֹת אֶת־ קַרְנ֣וֹת הַגּוֹיִ֗ם הַנֹּשְׂאִ֥ים קֶ֛רֶן אֶל־ אֶ֥רֶץ יְהוּדָ֖ה לְזָרוֹתָֽהּ׃ס
